# Stage 02-foundation: Foundation

[← 01-validate](./01-validate.md) · [all stages](./README.md) · [03-build →](./03-build.md)

**Purpose.** Set up the legal entity, banking, tax, data protection, contracts and basic financial controls.

**Exit gate.** Entity registered, bank account open, required licences and data registrations filed or scheduled, lawyer and accountant engaged.
